content.title: Synthetic classification rule fixture
content.rule_statement: For this schema fixture only, cash, receivables, and inventory are treated as current assets while equipment is not.
content.applicability: Schema validation only; this record is neither admitted accounting evidence nor a G2 sample rule.

assertions.claim: Add the fixture's cash, receivables, and inventory amounts to obtain its current-assets subtotal.

currency.basis: Synthetic calibration rule is current only within its closed fixture world; a real candidate must bind admitted current authority.
